messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants a brief about the movie "全面啟動" (which is "Inception") and then retrieve extra info like director, cast, awards for Inception, and also for "黑暗騎士" (The Dark Knight). The function movie_details_brief can retrieve brief or extra info. We need to call it twice: once for Inception with extra_info true, and once for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. The function signature: title: string, extra_info?: boolean. So we should call twice.

We need to output the brief first? The user says "先提供簡介，再檢索有關同一部電影的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息". So we need to provide the brief for Inception, then extra info for Inception, then extra info for The Dark Knight. We can do separate calls. But we might combine into one call? The function only returns one movie at a time. So we need two calls. We can do them sequentially. We'll call movie_details_brief for Inception with extra_info true. Then call again for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. The brief is part of the response from the function. So we can just call with extra_info true for Inception; that will give us brief plus extra info. Then call for The Dark Knight. That satisfies the request.

Thus we produce two function calls.
